rule:
Symlink the head_rgb.mp4 of the latest successful first_demo demo per (task, object).

Rules
  * task     = subtask directory under first_demo (alignment-world_horizontal excluded)
  * success  = meta.json status == "success" and head_rgb.mp4 present,
               minus runs the owner vetoed in the ledger ("NOT a valid demo")
  * object   = alias minus subtask prefix / support suffix / model-id and placement-variant suffixes
               (so dishwasher == dishwasher_wide, carton_cdmmwy == carton_cdmmwy_near/_lever, blender == blender_eyedvd)
  * latest   = most recent meta.json mtime (demo completion) within the (task, object) group
